Pretrain a Variational Autoencoder on Species Composition

Source: R/resolve.R
resolve.pretrain_vae.Rd

Train a variational autoencoder to reconstruct each plot's species vector, without labels: a compressed representation of composition learned from the plots alone.

Usage

resolve.pretrain_vae(dataset, config = list())

Arguments

dataset

A ResolveDataset loaded with config = list(species_encoding = "sparse"), which carries each plot's species vector.

config

Named list of VAE settings (latent_dim, encoder_dims, decoder_dims, dropout, kl_weight, kl_anneal_epochs, pretrain_epochs, pretrain_lr, pretrain_weight_decay, batch_size, device, seed); a field left out takes the RESOLVE engine's default (resolve.default_config() "vae").

Value

A list with the per-epoch loss_history, recon_loss_history and kl_loss_history, total_time_seconds, epochs_completed, latent_dim and projection_weights, the encoder's first layer (one row per unit of its first hidden layer, one column per species of the vocabulary).

Examples

plots <- system.file("extdata", "plots.csv", package = "resolveR")
species <- system.file("extdata", "species.csv", package = "resolveR")
roles <- list(plot_id = "plot_id", species_id = "species", abundance = "cover",
              genus = "genus", family = "family", latitude = "lat", longitude = "lon")
targets <- list(elevation = list(column = "elevation", task = "regression"),
                habitat = list(column = "habitat", task = "classification"))
dataset <- resolve.dataset.csv(plots, species, roles = roles, targets = targets,
                               config = list(species_encoding = "sparse"))
vae <- resolve.pretrain_vae(dataset, list(latent_dim = 4, pretrain_epochs = 20))
plot(vae$loss_history, type = "l")
